current.jp: 彼らはいつも学校をサボっています。
current.kana: かれらわいつもがっこうをさぼっています。

structure_explanation.en: The topic 彼ら (they) is marked by は. The object 学校 (school) is marked by を, and the verb is サボる (to skip/cut class) in the polite continuous form 〜ています (サボっています). The target いつも (always) indicates frequency: skipping class is a recurring habit of theirs.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O tópico 彼ら (eles) é marcado por は. O objeto 学校 (escola) é marcado por を, e o verbo é サボる (faltar/matar aula) na forma contínua cortês 〜ています (サボっています). O alvo いつも (sempre) indica frequência: matar aula é um hábito recorrente deles.

translation_literal.en: They (as for them) are always skipping school (polite).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Eles (quanto a) sempre escola (objeto) faltando estão (cortês).

gloss.en: to skip class, to play hooky (on purpose)

note.en: サボっ = te-form (音便) of サボる, linking to て
note.pt-BR: サボっ = forma-て (音便) de サボる, ligando-se a て

note.en: い (of いる) after the te-form forms the continuous/habitual aspect 〜ている
note.pt-BR: い (de いる) após a forma-て forma o aspecto contínuo/habitual 〜ている

objections.objection: Same Layer-A breach as 9454297: gen=false Tatoeba record, `before.texts.translation` has only pt-BR, and the patch inserts an AI-authored English ("They're always skipping school.") into the Layer-A `en` slot. Layer-A source English for a real Tatoeba sentence may not be replaced by generated text, and the op's named field (record-level `en`) is left untouched.
